The market did not make an uncorrected sizing error; it made a momentum trade it has already unwound, so most of the draft's claimed disagreement is with a consensus that no longer exists. What survives is narrower and better: the residual price is not a story premium, so the error, if any, is about the durability of a single harvest year of free cash flow (EV 20.30x the filed base, 40.50x the four-year average of a series containing -926.5m) rather than about the project. A disagreement, a category and a dated falsifier all still exist, so method section 7's independence cap is not triggered.

challenges.attack: Does Yarlung Tsangpo TBM demand reach THIS issuer's P&L at the size the draft assumes? The draft splits 5.0-7.5bn across 'at least two qualified domestic suppliers' over a decade and does not say who leads. 中铁装备 (CREG), the equipment arm of 中国中铁 and the operator of the country's largest TBM base at Zhengzhou, is publicly described as first in the world in TBM production and sales for eight consecutive years, with Chinese brands holding roughly two thirds to 70% of the world market and the field also including 北方重工, 中交天和 and 上海隧道. On pricing, the customer is the state: CRCC holds 71.93%, the actual controller is SASAC, and the related-party note discloses recurring sales into the parent's own construction bureaus. A directed allocation inside a state programme is a volume promise, not a price promise, and the FY2025 accounts already show what that looks like: the TBM line's revenue -7.24% with gross margin -3.14 points, and the shaft, inclined-shaft and hard-rock sub-line, the closest match to a long headrace tunnel, -12.85% with margin -2.21 points.
challenges.outcome: LANDED, in the direction that makes the dive more negative rather than less, which is recorded because a capture attack that only confirms is not an attack. The draft's roughly 520m a year, 5.2% of revenue, is if anything generous: it assumes an even split with the volume leader rather than a share loss, it ignores three further qualified suppliers, and it prices no margin concession to a monopsony that includes the issuer's own parent. No number in the file is changed, because moving the sizing down would only widen a gap the verdict does not need widened.

challenges.attack: Is grade C generous, and would D forbid anything the draft relies on? Two attacks. First, the draft graded C on DSO and deferred drift and treated the capex collapse as a valuation input rather than a third flag, and it missed a fourth: reported revenue printed 10,101.55 / 10,027.47 / 10,046.04 / 10,045.30 CNY m across FY2022-FY2025, a four-year spread of 0.74%, with FY2025 landing within 745,753 CNY of FY2024, 0.0074% on a ten billion base, in a year when mainland revenue fell 18.14% and overseas rose 109.62%. Second, test what D would do.
challenges.outcome: LANDED on the first, which is added to earnings_quality.inputs and to the grade's basis: flatness to seven parts in a hundred thousand over that mix shift is a smoothing signature, and on section 7's words for D, multiple severe flags, a D is defensible. THE GRADE STAYS C on the second, and the reason is a defect in the method rather than a judgement about the issuer: section 7's table makes C cap the verdict at WATCH while D only forbids INVESTABLE, so C is STRICTER than D as written and a D would leave TOO_LATE available where C does not. Re-grading would relax the constraint this dive relies on. The non-monotonic ladder is escalated to Ron in the dive log, not resolved here.

challenges.attack: The draft says three independent locks and treats the 3.35 price trigger as a monitoring line. Stress it instead of accepting it. At 3.35 the market capitalisation is 17,867.2m and, against net cash of 1,098.3m, the enterprise value is 16,768.9m, so EV over the filed base free cash flow goes from 20.30x to 16.47x and through the same solve the implied five-year ask falls from 8.45% to roughly 3.5%, taking the gap from -7.88pp to roughly -2.9pp, from three times the file's own 2.60pp band to about 1.1x it.
challenges.outcome: LANDED. A 17.9% drawdown does most of the work of closing the valuation gap, which is more than the draft claimed for the trigger, and the trigger note is amended to say so. It also proves the draft ordered its own locks wrongly: price can nearly neutralise lock (2) and cannot touch lock (1), because grade C caps at WATCH at any price. verdict_basis is re-ranked to put the earnings grade first. No entry zone is created at 3.35 or anywhere else: drawing a band at a price the grade-C cap forbids acting on is exactly the entry-basis defect this attack exists to catch.

challenges.attack: Ron's decision of 2026-09-03 requires every WATCH to carry a would_buy_zone or a named cap. Test whether a price exists at which this file would actually buy, or whether the grade-C cap forecloses the question before price is even reached, and, if a conditional zone can be computed, whether it survives the surviving bear case (a company that has not grown being asked to compound, mainland revenue down 18.14%) rather than smuggling in a recovery.
challenges.outcome: CAP BINDS, NOT PRICE. earnings_quality.veto_applied already establishes that grade C caps the verdict at WATCH independent of valuation, and entry_basis_stress in the first red team already showed a 17.9% drawdown to 3.35 narrows the gap to about -2.9pp without lifting the cap. Doing the arithmetic anyway rather than treating the cap as an excuse: replicating the filed reverse-DCF and varying price instead of the discount rate this file already flagged as unstressed, the net_gap_direction row closes at price ~2.97 (implied ask equals this dive's own 0.57% path) and enters the file's own 2.60pp horizon_spread band by price ~3.30, both recorded in would_buy_if_uncapped and tagged SPECULATIVE because they price a contract-liabilities recovery this file has not observed. The conditional zone survives the bear-case check on its own terms, because 0.57%-3.17% FCF growth is what a company with flat four-year revenue and an 18.14% mainland decline would need to be worth 2.97-3.30 without any recovery. It does not survive as a standing offer: it prices out only the deferred-revenue flag and is silent on the DSO and capex flags that remain, so it is not treated as an entry_zone and no number in verdict, grade or price_ref moves.

pre_mortem: ORDERS LED AND I READ THE LAGGING SERIES. H1 2026 TBM order intake was 3.961bn, 62.2% of the whole of FY2025, and the annual report itself attributes the FY2025 revenue fall to the prior year's order fall. If orders lead revenue by about a year, FY2027 recovers, the 1.5% revenue row and the 15.0% margin row are both too low, and customer advances refill as the new book takes deposits, which is precisely the falsifier this file named against itself.

THE CAPEX HOLIDAY WAS A REAL STRUCTURAL CHANGE AND I CALLED IT A DISTORTION. Capex ran 2.03x depreciation in FY2023 and net property, plant and equipment went from 5.59bn to 7.30bn; the plant is built. If 0.09x is the start of a long harvest rather than a one-year hole, base free cash flow near 1.0bn is the run rate, the 2.00x-the-average argument is wrong, and 20.30x enterprise value to free cash flow on a net-cash, SASAC-controlled supplier into a decade-long state programme is not a demanding price.

THE DISCOUNT RATE DID THE WORK AND I LEFT IT AT THE FILED 9%. On a CNY-denominated net-cash issuer against a sub-2% ten-year government bond, 7.5% puts the implied ask inside this file's own error band and 7.0% flips the sign of the gap. The -7.88pp headline is as much a statement about one unpublished assumption as about the price, and this analyst's log has now recorded a convention defect in this column on four consecutive dives.
red_team.pre_mortem_conclusion: The market-would-have-been-right story is articulable three ways and the third is the one I would bet on, so method section 7's pre-mortem gate does not force a downgrade; the verdict is already at WATCH, which is the floor that gate can impose. It does not force TOO_LATE either, and TOO_LATE was re-tested here rather than inherited from the draft: section 7 conditions it on the decomposition showing multiple EXPANSION having eaten the runway, and this decomposition shows -27.98% of multiple over twelve months against a -1.65% earnings base, with the share 0.97% below its last pre-announcement close. No shadow row is created, and the reason is the vocabulary rather than an unwillingness to say no. That is the sixth consecutive decline and it is escalated in the dive log, not smoothed over here.
red_team.surviving_bear_case: What survives every attack is narrower than the draft and still says no. Strip the Yarlung Tsangpo story out entirely, because the market already has: the premium round-tripped inside thirteen months, the retail article that carried the basket printed the correct 25-machine, roughly 6bn sizing while the crowd was buying, and the first hydro-tunnelling award anywhere in the issuer's own disclosure is 236m, 2.35% of revenue, eleven months later and unattributed to the scheme. What is left is a company whose reported revenue has not moved 1% in four years while its mainland business fell 18.14%, whose TBM line gave up 3.14 points of gross margin to a customer base that includes its own 71.93% parent and whose likely largest rival has been the world's biggest TBM builder for eight years, whose receivables sit at 314 days, whose customer advances halved in a year, and whose entire free cash flow base exists because capex was cut to 0.09x depreciation. Against that the price still asks for high-single-digit free cash flow compounding on the filed assumptions, and although a 150 basis point cut in an unpublished discount rate would shrink that ask to inside this file's own error band, no reading of the valuation makes the name cheap enough to overcome a grade-C book. The verdict is WATCH because the earnings quality caps it there, not because the valuation is finely balanced, and the one datum that would change it is contract liabilities back above 1.0bn.

would_buy_basis: NULL: earnings grade C caps the verdict at WATCH at any price (method section 7), so no would_buy_zone is drawn regardless of where the shares trade; the cap lifts only if contract liabilities (合同负债) recover above the 1,000,000,000 CNY watch_triggers[0] level, last held at 1,118,911,017.44 twelve months before the 538,788,644.17 print, observable at the 2026 interim balance sheet or the FY2026 annual report. The conditional zone that arithmetic implies once that one condition is met is recorded in would_buy_if_uncapped, tagged SPECULATIVE because it prices a state the file does not yet report.

would_buy_if_uncapped.basis: The net_gap_direction row closes at these prices. Replicating the filed reverse-DCF exactly as red_team.stress_computations already validated (base_fcf 1,017,988,684.88, discount rate 9%, terminal growth 2.5%, 5-year horizon; the replication reproduces the filed column to three decimals, 8.447% against a filed 0.0845), and now varying enterprise value (price) instead of the discount rate that stress left fixed: EV = price x 5,333,497,000 shares - net cash 1,098,287,073 (the same net-cash figure the 3.35 trigger stress used). At EV ~14,757,955,110 (price ~2.97) the implied FCF CAGR the price asks for falls to 0.57%, exactly this dive's own net_gap_direction my_expectation, closing the gap to zero. At EV ~16,524,352,905 (price ~3.30) the implied ask is 3.17%, the edge of this file's own 2.60pp horizon_spread band around that same 0.57% path, so the gap is no longer a gap by the file's own rule at any price at or below 3.30. High = 3.30 (upper edge, gap enters the file's own error band), low = 2.97 (gap fully closed). Both bounds sit inside 0.3x-2.0x of the last close 4.08 in data/market/688425-SS.json series.rows (bounds 1.224-8.16) and strictly below price_ref.value.
would_buy_if_uncapped.bear_case_check: This zone prices flat-to-near-zero FCF growth (0.57%-3.17%), which is what the surviving bear case already describes: revenue has not moved more than 0.74% in four years, mainland revenue fell 18.14% in FY2025, and the TBM line lost 3.14 points of gross margin. The zone does not require the mainland decline to reverse or margin to recover, so it is a genuine margin-of-safety band rather than one smuggling in a recovery assumption. It does NOT survive independently of the single named trigger: it assumes contract liabilities are the only earnings-quality flag standing between grade C and something better, and leaves the DSO drift (314.35 days) and the capex-to-depreciation cut (0.09x) unaddressed. Method section 7's ladder does not say what grade a name gets when one of three flags clears and two remain, and that gap is the same non-monotonic-ladder question the earnings_quality block already escalated to Ron rather than a new finding.
